title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Numbers 17: the twelve rods laid up before Yahweh and Aaron's rod that sprouted, blossomed and bore ripe almonds.

questions.text: How many rods did Yahweh tell Moses to take from the princes of the fathers' houses?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to take one rod for each fathers' house from all their princes, twelve rods.

questions.text: Whose name was to be written on Levi's rod?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You shall write Aaron's name on Levi's rod."

questions.text: Where were the rods to be laid up?
questions.explanation: The rods were to be laid up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where Yahweh met with Moses.

answers.text: In the Tent of Meeting before the covenant
On the altar of burnt offering in the court
In Moses' own tent at the edge of the camp
On the top of the mountain before the people

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen to the rod of the man he chose?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that the rod of the man whom he would choose would bud.

answers.text: It would turn into a serpent

questions.text: What did Yahweh want to make cease by this sign?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against Moses, cease from him.

answers.text: The murmurings of the children of Israel

questions.text: When did Moses go into the Tent of the Testimony and find Aaron's rod had sprouted?
questions.explanation: On the next day Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron's rod had sprouted.

questions.text: What did Aaron's rod produce besides buds and blossoms?
questions.explanation: Aaron's rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms and borne ripe almonds.

questions.text: What happened after Moses brought all the rods out to the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh; the people looked, and each man took his rod.

answers.text: The rods were burned on the altar
The rods were given to Aaron
The rods were broken in pieces

questions.text: Why was Aaron's rod to be put back before the covenant?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to keep it as a token against the children of rebellion, to end their complaining against him so that they would not die.

answers.text: As a staff for Aaron's son Eleazar to carry
As a tool for striking the rock in the wilderness
As a gift to be shared among the princes
As a token against the children of rebellion

questions.text: What did the children of Israel say happens to everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh's tabernacle?
questions.explanation: The people said, "Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh's tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?"

answers.text: They would become unclean for seven days
They would be sent out of the camp
